reports.title: Sunny Day on the Bow
reports.comment:
quick: Took a tour up to the Bow Glacier,
Heard lots of whumpfing as we were getting on the glacier. Higher up on it the wind effect was very noticeable, snow varied from 15cm to 50cm depending on the pocket on the glacier.
Lower down made for some great turns with snow depth ranging from calf to knee deep. / weather: Winds on and off through the day, strong winds kicked in just after lunch up on …

reports.title: Toe of the Bow
reports.comment:
trip: Made the long walk out to the toe of the bow glacier to get a feel for conditions in the alpine and search for early season turns. We carried our skis all the way to the glacier with ~10cm of snow on top of the rocks for the approach along the summer trail.

Arriving at the toe we were pleasantly surprised to find good skiing with 20cm of facet pow not yet affected by the winds. A hasty dig …

reports.title: Rocket Man
reports.comment:

reports.title: Bow Hut to Mt Rhondda + Mount Habel (CT at base
reports.comment: trip: Ski touring across Wapta icefield and a summit of Rhondda on Nov. 13, 2026. Group of 3. Snow was variable with wind loading in areas, no shooting cracks or whumphing. Descended Rhondda then did a CT at the base of Mount Habel: CTM13 30cm down, RP. Included pics, At spot of the column test I lost 1 of my touring skis down the slope. reports.title: Enough for a walk, skiing is questionable
reports.comment: trip: Went out for a quick tour to enjoy some mountain exercise. There’s maybe 20cm of snow, faceted, surface hoar forming on top. Views were nice, skied with extreme caution due to low snow depth.

reports.title: Dogleg
reports.comment:
trip: Went to ski dogleg on Nov 23. Bow summit trail coverage is good. The traverse to the couloir is a bit sharky.
Beside the top, the couloir has a lot of snow in it, up to a meter at some places. Didn't touch anything in the couloir. We noticed a 3-4cm crust at some places with facets under it, but no sign of instability.

reports.title: Crowfoot Falls
reports.comment: trip: Bailed off of the last pitch of Crowfoot Falls after getting 2 bouts of significant spindrift. There was about 3-4 cm of new snow on the approach slope and large snow slope after the approach ice pitch. When the wind picked up around 11 AM, we noticed wind blowing snow around us. New D1 dry loose occurred on snow slope above approach ice and occurred while we were climbing around 12 PM.
